# Punctual - Smart Alarm for iPhone

> Punctual is a premium alarm app for iPhone (iOS 26+, built on Apple's AlarmKit,
> rings through Silent mode and Focus). Core is free forever with no ads: live
> countdown to the next ring, heads-up notification before the alarm, and Skip
> Today (skip one day, alarm stays armed for tomorrow). Pro ($1.99/mo, $9.99/yr,
> $19.99 lifetime) adds vacation pause, custom heads-ups, alarm groups, calendar
> auto-skip, themes, icons, custom heads-up sounds. No data collection.

- [Support](https://punctualalarm.com/support.html): troubleshooting
